query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT $this ?duiValue ?caseValue
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ?duiNode ;
                       nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?caseNode .
                ?duiNode qudt:numericValue ?duiValue .
                ?caseNode nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?caseDisplacementNode .
                ?caseDisplacementNode qudt:numericValue ?caseValue .

                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    $this nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?greaterCaseNode .
                    ?greaterCaseNode nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?greaterDisplacementNode .
                    ?greaterDisplacementNode qudt:numericValue ?greaterValue .
                    FILTER (?greaterValue > ?caseValue)
                }

                FILTER (
                    ABS(?duiValue - ?caseValue) >
                    (0.000001 * ABS(?caseValue) + 0.000000001)
                )
            }
review_note: The NOT EXISTS greater-case subquery selects a maximal linked case displacement, then compares DUI to that maximum. Both operands and the tolerance expression were inspected; the retained negative is outside that tolerance and the repair restores the exact maximum.

query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
            PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:damageCenterForwardOfMaxBreadth ?forward ;
                      nltl:upperIceWaterlineLength ?lengthNode ;
                      nltl:upperIceWaterlineDraught ?draughtNode ;
                      nltl:longitudinalDamageExtent ?longNode ;
                      nltl:verticalDamageExtent ?verticalNode .

                ?lengthNode qudt:numericValue ?length .
                ?draughtNode qudt:numericValue ?draught .
                ?longNode qudt:numericValue ?longitudinal .
                ?verticalNode qudt:numericValue ?vertical .

                BIND(IF(?forward = true,
                        "0.045"^^xsd:decimal * ?length,
                        "0.015"^^xsd:decimal * ?length) AS ?expectedLongitudinal)
                BIND(IF("0.20"^^xsd:decimal * ?draught < ?expectedLongitudinal,
                        "0.20"^^xsd:decimal * ?draught,
                        ?expectedLongitudinal) AS ?expectedVertical)

                FILTER (
                    ABS(?longitudinal - ?expectedLongitudinal) >
                    IF(
                        ABS(?expectedLongitudinal) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal >
                        "0.000000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                        ABS(?expectedLongitudinal) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                        "0.000000001"^^xsd:decimal
                    )
                    ||
                    ABS(?vertical - ?expectedVertical) >
                    IF(
                        ABS(?expectedVertical) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal >
                        "0.000000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                        ABS(?expectedVertical) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                        "0.000000001"^^xsd:decimal
                    )
                )
            }
review_note: The SELECTs implement 0.045L/0.015L by the unchanged forward selector, min(0.20T,longitudinal), and vertical-position bounds 0..1.20T. The corresponding disjunct and stored numeric delta were reviewed; tolerances are recorded rather than treated as a general source equivalence.

query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:damageCenterForwardOfMaxBreadth ?forward ;
                      nltl:upperIceWaterlineLength ?lengthNode ;
                      nltl:upperIceWaterlineDraught ?draughtNode ;
                      nltl:longitudinalDamageExtent ?longitudinalNode ;
                      nltl:verticalDamageExtent ?verticalNode ;
                      nltl:selectedVerticalDamagePosition ?positionNode .

                ?lengthNode qudt:numericValue ?length .
                ?draughtNode qudt:numericValue ?draught .
                ?longitudinalNode qudt:numericValue ?longitudinal .
                ?verticalNode qudt:numericValue ?vertical .
                ?positionNode qudt:numericValue ?position .

                BIND(IF(?forward = true,
                        ?length * 0.045,
                        ?length * 0.015) AS ?expectedLongitudinal)
                BIND(IF(?draught * 0.20 < ?expectedLongitudinal,
                        ?draught * 0.20,
                        ?expectedLongitudinal) AS ?expectedVertical)
                BIND((?expectedLongitudinal * 0.000001) + 0.000000001 AS ?longitudinalTolerance)
                BIND((?expectedVertical * 0.000001) + 0.000000001 AS ?verticalTolerance)

                FILTER (
                    ?longitudinal < (?expectedLongitudinal - ?longitudinalTolerance) ||
                    ?longitudinal > (?expectedLongitudinal + ?longitudinalTolerance) ||
                    ?vertical < (?expectedVertical - ?verticalTolerance) ||
                    ?vertical > (?expectedVertical + ?verticalTolerance) ||
                    ?position < 0.0 ||
                    ?position > (?draught * 1.20)
                )
            }
review_note: The SELECTs implement 0.045L/0.015L by the unchanged forward selector, min(0.20T,longitudinal), and vertical-position bounds 0..1.20T. The corresponding disjunct and stored numeric delta were reviewed; tolerances are recorded rather than treated as a general source equivalence.

query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:hasComponent ?pump .
                ?pump a ?pumpType .
                FILTER (
                    ?pumpType IN (
                        nltl:firePump,
                        nltl:emergencyFirePump,
                        nltl:waterMistPump,
                        nltl:waterSprayPump
                    )
                )
                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    ?pump nltl:hasContainingCompartment ?compartment .
                    ?compartment nltl:maintainedTemperature ?quantity .
                    ?quantity qudt:numericValue ?value ;
                              qudt:unit unit:DEG_C .
                    FILTER (
                        datatype(?value) = xsd:decimal &&
                        ?value > 0
                    )
                }
            }
review_note: The SELECT traverses each recognized fire-pump type to its containing compartment and requires a decimal Celsius temperature >0. The repaired unit belongs to that same containing compartment, rather than to the ship or pump.

query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>

SELECT $this
WHERE {
    $this nltl:survivalSupportDuration ?supportNode .
    ?supportNode qudt:numericValue ?supportValue .
    $this nltl:maximumExpectedRescueTime ?rescueNode .
    ?rescueNode qudt:numericValue ?rescueValue .

}

query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:operatingForeDraught ?ofq .
                ?ofq qudt:numericValue ?of .
                $this nltl:operatingAftDraught ?oaq .
                ?oaq qudt:numericValue ?oa .
                $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtFore ?minfq .
                ?minfq qudt:numericValue ?minf .
                $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtFore ?maxfq .
                ?maxfq qudt:numericValue ?maxf .
                $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtAft ?minaq .
                ?minaq qudt:numericValue ?mina .
                $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtAft ?maxaq .
                ?maxaq qudt:numericValue ?maxa .
                FILTER (
                    !(?minf <= ?of && ?of <= ?maxf &&
                      ?mina <= ?oa && ?oa <= ?maxa)
                )
            }
review_note: The SELECT joins fore/aft operating and minimum/maximum ice-class draught quantities. The repaired aft value is the only out-of-range conjunct/disjunct; fore and all limits remain unchanged.

query:

PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this
WHERE {
    $this nltl:operatingForeDraught ?ofq .
    ?ofq qudt:numericValue ?of .
    $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtFore ?maxfq .
    ?maxfq qudt:numericValue ?maxf .
    $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtFore ?minfq .
    ?minfq qudt:numericValue ?minf .
    $this nltl:operatingAftDraught ?oaq .
    ?oaq qudt:numericValue ?oa .
    $this nltl:maximumIceClassDraughtAft ?maxaq .
    ?maxaq qudt:numericValue ?maxa .
    $this nltl:minimumIceClassDraughtAft ?minaq .
    ?minaq qudt:numericValue ?mina .
    FILTER (
        ?of < ?minf ||
        ?of > ?maxf ||
        ?oa < ?mina ||
        ?oa > ?maxa
    )
}

query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:iceClass ?iceClass .
                FILTER (?iceClass IN (nltl:iceClassIb, nltl:iceClassIc))

                $this nltl:ballastConditionPropellerTopDepth ?depthQuantity .
                ?depthQuantity qudt:numericValue ?depth .
                ?depthQuantity qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M> .

                $this nltl:requiredPropellerSubmersionDepthHi ?hiQuantity .
                ?hiQuantity qudt:numericValue ?hi .
                ?hiQuantity qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M> .

                FILTER (
                    datatype(?depth) = xsd:decimal &&
                    datatype(?hi) = xsd:decimal &&
                    ?depth < ?hi
                )

                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    $this nltl:propulsionSystemDesignedForIceClass nltl:iceClassIa .
                }
            }
review_note: IB/IC plus top-depth<hi activate NOT EXISTS redesign for IA, on the same ship; the omitted redesign assertion is the intended failure.

The unchanged CP and pitchValueKnown=false guard activates the missing canonical free/bollard pitch pair with bollard=0.7*free. The free-running quantity is missing, not merely numerically discrepant.
